title: Nhận định Iraq vs Na Uy — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook split-frame — Aymen Hussein (Iraq) vs Haaland (Na Uy), cúp World Cup ở giữa
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a 2026 FIFA World Cup group-stage showdown. Left half: Aymen Hussein, the Iraqi striker for the Iraq national team, in a white Iraq home kit with green trim and the Iraq Football Association eagle crest clearly visible on the chest, determined fierce hero pose. Behind him, a stylized white-and-green Iraq graphic backdrop with a huge faint eagle crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Erling Haaland, the Norwegian striker for the Norway national team, in a bright red Norway home kit with navy trim and the Norwegian Football Federation lion crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring powerful hero pose. Behind him, a stylized red Norway graphic backdrop with a huge faint lion crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the golden FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday rivalry promotional poster. Both crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
